name: Whello CS Rotator
author: Whello Indonesia

sections.description:
Whello CS Rotator is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to manage WhatsApp customer service staff and automatically rotate customer inquiries based on various logic including working hours, shifts, and staff availability.

The plugin allows businesses to efficiently manage their WhatsApp customer service operations by:

  • Creating and managing staff profiles with detailed work schedules
  • Setting up WhatsApp links with customized rotation rules
  • Tracking performance and lead generation
  • Providing a seamless customer experience with automatic staff rotation

Key Features

  • Staff Management: Create and manage customer service staff profiles with detailed information and work schedules
  • Link Management: Create WhatsApp links with customized rotation rules and tracking options
  • Automatic Rotation: Distribute customer inquiries based on working hours, shifts, and staff availability
  • Performance Tracking: Monitor staff performance and lead generation
  • Setup Wizard: Easy 3-step setup process to get started quickly
  • Custom Loading Page: Customize the loading page that appears before redirecting to WhatsApp
  • Mobile-Friendly: Works perfectly on all devices
  • Third-Party Tracking Integration: Support for Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Google Ads, and Meta Pixels for comprehensive conversion tracking

Pro Version Features

The Pro version of Whello CS Rotator offers additional features:
* Advanced rotation logic
* Enhanced performance analytics
* Additional customization options
* Priority support

Support

For support, please visit https://plugins.whello.id/panduan-penggunaan/ or contact us at dev@whello.id.

Third-Party Libraries and Services

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries and services:

International Telephone Input (intl-tel-input)

  • Version: 25.3.1
  • Description: A JavaScript plugin for entering and validating international telephone numbers
  • External source code: https://github.com/jackocnr/intl-tel-input
  • Internal source code location: /admin/lib/intl-tel-input/src/
  • License: MIT
  • Used for: Phone number input and validation in staff forms

Third-Party Tracking Services

This plugin integrates with the following third-party tracking services:

  • Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Google Analytics (GA)
  • Google Ads (Conversion Tracking)
  • Meta Pixels (Facebook Conversion API)

These services are used for tracking conversions and measuring the effectiveness of WhatsApp links. The plugin allows you to configure tracking IDs and events for each service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wh-csrotator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Follow the setup wizard to configure basic settings, add staff members, and create your first WhatsApp link
sections.faq:
How does the staff rotation work?

The plugin rotates customer service staff based on their working hours, shifts, and availability. You can set up detailed work schedules for each staff member, and the plugin will automatically select the appropriate staff member when a customer clicks on a WhatsApp link.

Can I track the performance of my customer service staff?

Yes, the Overview page provides performance metrics for your staff members, including the number of leads generated and other relevant statistics.

Is the plugin compatible with WhatsApp Business API?

The plugin works with regular WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business. For WhatsApp Business API integration, please contact us for custom solutions.

How do I create a new WhatsApp link?

After setting up your staff members, go to the Links section and click “Add New Link”. Fill in the required information, assign staff members, and set up tracking options if needed.
